name: onshape-cadscript
description: Design and verify printable Onshape models with a script-first CadScript workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Create printable Onshape models with Codex
interface.longDescription: A local-first, script-driven CAD workflow for hobby 3D printing. Codex edits one typed model file, previews sketches, plans exact Onshape changes, applies them through your signed-in browser session, and verifies rendered geometry before export.
defaultPrompt: Create a printable Onshape model from my idea.
Modify this CadScript model and verify the result.
Make a tolerance test coupon for my printer.
